analysis_source: Nepal Flood WASH Severity Analysis - Master Data
notes: Official model weights: P1 50%, P2 35%, P3 15%.
P1 is WASH-weighted: 40% affected-population impact and 60% WSS impact where DDA is available.
P2 uses direct service and water-safety/public-health evidence adjusted by an assessed-WSS-beneficiary / affected-population coverage proxy.
The P2 coverage ratio is a proxy, not a unique population coverage rate; scheme beneficiary populations may overlap and the ratio is capped at 100%.
Municipalities without current DDA use a provisional P2 prior of 2.5 and are flagged as lower-confidence evidence.
No second rank-derived severity class is used; the published class is the absolute Need Score class.
5W response monitoring is not yet ingested.
Exact DDA infrastructure coordinates remain non-public.
